about_the_game:
THIS GAME IS STILL IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT, SO YOU MIGHT ENCOUNTER THESE THINGS WHEN PLAYING:

  • MISSING TEXTURES

  • MISSING ANIMATIONS

  • LACK OF OBJECTIVE

  • ACCESS TO DEBUG FEATURES

The darkness brews, the evil within these people has stirred and stirred until their shells weren't enough. They have strayed from the path. With these righteous weapons of God and by being in unity with others of your faith, grasp at victory over evil.

This is a multiplayer shooter about advancing through a linear level with 2 friends and shooting your way through hordes of Venetian carnival goers that had their minds corrupted by a heretical deity.

Push until the end of Venice in a single go to destroy their false idols and complete the game

The game includes:

  • A controllable first person player

  • A gun on that player

  • Connecting with your friends through steam to be in the same space

  • A level to walk around in

  • One spot where you can shoot at zombies

  • Zombies that walk at you if you get close enough

content_descriptors.notes: This is a game about shooting guns with bullets at zombie-like enemies, that's the violence that you're gonna be seeing, gunshots and blood VFX, with the occasional explosion from a grenade on top of that.

  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Rise children of the almighty and be guided to your salvation. You must trek a path of mud and blood, but if you walk it together, you will surely have enough strength to tear through these beasts, once human, but no longer.
